column3: Close to the Hebrew; the future “will totally destroy” is rendered “has utterly destroyed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “rot away” is rendered “be dissolved.”
Close to the Hebrew; “has drunk its fill” is rendered “shall be bathed,” and “people of My total destruction” “people of My curse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “drink its fill” is rendered “be soaked.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sulfur” is rendered “brimstone.”
Close to the Hebrew; the birds and animals are rendered “the pelican and the porcupine… the owl,” and “formlessness” (tohu) “confusion.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV restructures the elliptical verse, “They shall call its nobles to the kingdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “grass” is rendered “A courtyard,” and “daughters of an ostrich” “ostriches.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִּילִית (Lilith) is rendered “the night creature,” and “hyenas” “the jackals.”
Close to the Hebrew; קִפּוֹז (qippoz) is rendered “the arrow snake,” and “black kites” “the hawks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “scroll” is rendered “book,” and NKJV capitalizes “His Spirit.”
